defs.def: to consider or study an idea, a subject, etc. very carefully 审查；调查；考查；考察

ex.s: In this book I examine three crucial stages in the history of mean sea level.
ex.t: 在本书中，我考察了平均海平面历史上的三个关键阶段。

ex.s: The researchers examined various levels of noise on participants as they completed tests of creative thinking.
ex.t: 研究人员在参与者完成创造性思维测试时，考察了不同程度噪音对他们造成的影响。

ex.s: This particular study examined 11 to 14-year-olds living in two-parent homes.
ex.t: 这项特别的研究考察了生活在双亲家庭中的 11 至 14 岁青少年。

ex.s: Several recent studies examined the role of talent in the sports world.
ex.t: 最近几项研究考察了天赋在体育界中的作用。

defs.def: to look at sb/sth closely, to see if there is anything wrong or to find the cause of a problem （仔细地）检查，检验

ex.s: To examine the difficulty of the tasks.
Drones are already being used to examine high-tension electrical lines.
ex.t: 它们可以做完全相同的事情来检查铁路线路和其他重要的铁路基础设施，如铁轨的正确位置和道岔。

ex.s: You have examined the equipment for safety before you start.
ex.t: 你在开始前已经检查了设备的安全性。

ex.s: Duck-billed platypus: The first scientists to examine a preserved platypus body judged it a fake in the late 18th century.
ex.t: 鸭嘴兽：最早检查一只保存完好的鸭嘴兽标本的科学家在18世纪末判定它是一个伪造品。

ex.s: A man shall see faces, that if you examine them, part by part, you shall find never a good; and yet all together do well.
ex.t: 一个人会看到一些面孔，如果你逐一审视它们的五官，你找不出任何一个好看的；然而整体看起来却很协调。

ex.s: Researchers used advanced technology to examine some of the objects on the ship.
ex.t: 研究人员使用先进技术检查了船上的部分物品。

ex.s: Because the water is so deep, it has been very difficult to examine the ship.
ex.t: 因为水太深了，检查这艘船一直非常困难。

defs.def: to give sb a test to see how much they know about a subject or what they can do 考，测验（某人）

ex.s: Knowing these causes can make us examine our behavior, and correct bad habits.
ex.t: 具有这些性格特征意味着处于愤怒前的状态，愤怒在你意识的背景中。

defs.def: to ask sb questions formally, especially in court （尤指在法庭上）审问，查问

是 习惯于 去 审查
困难的 去 审查
